liz-b: Heads-up: CloudOne go-live in 7 days. Need final decision on how trial credits appear in partner exports and our dispute timeline. Also confirm inbound payload fields.

raj: I'll own the SKU mapping. CloudOne sends compute_ms and requests. We should support an explicit unit_type and avoid implicit conversions.

nina-billing: Proposal: represent trial credits as entitlement events with fields: entitlement_type=trial, amount_units, expires_at. Exports should include entitlement_id so partners can join.

paul-integrations: Webhook contract: require X-Partner-Signature and partner_txn_id. Support batched usage arrays and include partner_sequence for ordering.

sam-sysops: Ingestion/ops notes: keep raw_reported (decimal) and normalized_billable (integer). Backfill policy: 45 days for marketplace; adjustments beyond 30 days need manual ops review.

maria-legal: We'll add contract language: partners have 60 days from daily export to raise disputes; exceptions for fraud/clerical errors.

partners-bot: Deploy notice: marketplace-ingest v2.15 deployed 1751001200

liz-b: Action items: raj -> SKU map PR, nina -> entitlement export format, paul -> webhook idempotency + docs, sam -> runbook TTL update, maria -> contract clause. Target: EOD Tuesday.

raj: Dropping initial SKU->plan map in this thread by tomorrow noon.

nina-billing: I'll include approval thresholds for negative adjustments in export schema (approval_id if >$5k).

liz-b: Thanks team. If blockers surface ping me. :white_check_mark:
